BreakBoss: rebuilt step sequencer. The original instrument faceplate and per-channel piano roll remain.

Please test:
- Open the sequencer from the original faceplate. Look for the silver chassis, generation/MIDI controls on the left, channel rack in the center, and searchable sound library on the right. On smaller screens the library shares the workspace as a drawer.
- Swipe the library categories or use arrows/tabs to browse Kicks, Claps, Snares, Rims, Hats, 808s and the other existing sounds. Preview a sound without changing the sequence.
- Drag a sound onto the rack or use its + button. The new header should grow from a circle into an oval. Add the same sound twice and verify independent steps, level, pan, tuning and mute/solo.
- The rack holds 12 sounds. Use New empty rack to start from scratch, remove a channel to make room, or Restore kit channels. A 13th sound should show a clear limit message.
- Draw/erase/select steps; test undo/redo, bars, zoom, snap, velocity/pitch lanes, per-channel piano roll, generation and recording. Verify kits change sounds and pattern presets change rhythms.
- Return to the original instrument and check that its pads still play after using an empty rack. Verify build 42 saved channel names, identities, samples and notes migrate correctly.
- Verify MIDI export/import, audio/stems, AUv3 MIDI playback, FOLLOW DAW and 128-frame operation on your device. Report clicks, stuck notes, loading errors or visual jumps.
